title: Structure array element stride includes end padding
summary: The element addresses of consecutive structure arrays differ by sizeof (element type), and the end of the member may not be the starting point of the next element.
applies: C11; Offline memory diagnostics and object representation
detail: In a common ABI where int is 4 bytes and aligned by 4, the size of struct { int n; char c; } is typically 8, with the second element starting at offset 8. See C11 §6.7.2.1, §6.5.3.4.
boundary: The packed file format may otherwise specify tight packing; in this case its declared record step size shall be used.
relevance: Check why the second record in the memory and the second record in the serialized file are misaligned.
